title: Vibrissa Test Case
description: One Vibrissa test case: a single operation (tool, resource, resourceTemplate or prompt) with expectations, or a multi-step flow under "steps".

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema (for editor completion).

resourceTemplate.description: RFC 6570 URI template, expanded with args, then read (resources/read).

args.description: Tool arguments, template variables, or prompt arguments. Strings may use {{capture}} and {{env.NAME}}.

expect.description: Expected (normalized) result. Exact match by default; matchers start with $ ($partial, $regex, $wildcard, $unordered, $any, $type, ...).

expectError.description: Expect the operation to fail (protocol error or tool isError result).

code.description: Error code name (InvalidParams, MethodNotFound, ResourceNotFound, RequestTimeout, UnsupportedProtocolVersion, ...) or numeric JSON-RPC code.

$regex.description: Regular expression the message must match.

respond.description: Scripted answers for server input requests (MRTR input_required rounds or legacy server requests), keyed by method: "elicitation/create", "sampling/createMessage", "roots/list". Values are the bare result, e.g. { "action": "accept", "content": { ... } }.

expectInputRequired.description: Matcher over the InputRequests map(s) the server sent before completing.

expectTask.description: Matcher over the CreateTaskResult when the server answers with a task (tasks extension).

await.description: Tasks extension: poll tasks/get until the task is terminal, then match the final result. true = defaults.

pollMs.description: Poll interval in ms. Default: the task pollIntervalMs, else 500.

timeoutMs.description: Give up after this many ms. Default 30000.

capture.description: Save values for later steps: name -> dotted path into the normalized result (e.g. "structuredContent.id").

budgetMs.description: Fail if this step takes longer than this many ms.

timeoutMs.description: Per-request timeout for this step (overrides config).

ignoreErrors.description: Never fail the case because of this step (teardown).

validateOutput.description: Validate structuredContent against the tool's outputSchema. Default true when one is declared.

normalize.description: Override config normalization for this step, or false to match the raw wire result.

stripMeta.description: Glob-ish keys to strip from every _meta object.

ttlMs.description: Keep or ignore list cache hints.

server.description: Key into config servers; default is defaultServer.

steps.description: Multi-step flow run on one session; top-level operation fields are ignored when present.

teardown.description: Steps run after the case, even when it failed.

flaky.description: Known-flaky: with --repeat, judged by pass rate instead of 100%.

skip.description: Skip this case (true, or a reason string).

step.description: One operation in a flow, with its expectations.
